completionPolicy.requires: All visible required core/branch choices and required text fields

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l10.intro
elements.html:
Trace a claim to relevant evidence and decide whether to share it.

Before sharing a claim, identify what would make it true or false. Find the original source, check date and context, and compare what it actually supports. A screenshot or confident paragraph can omit important details. A source link is useful only if it exists and supports the claim. You can conclude “not enough evidence” and withhold a claim; verification is not a contest to defend the tool.

Practice scenario

Fictional viral post: “All school buses are cancelled tomorrow.” Evidence card A: a cropped screenshot with no date. Card B: the school transport page, updated today, says Route 7 is delayed by 20 minutes; other routes run normally.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l10.claim
elements.title: Which statement is supported by the supplied cards?

choices.text: The current page reports a Route 7 delay, not all-route cancellation.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l10.claim.feedback.all
elements.html: Neither card supports that broad claim.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l10.claim.feedback.limited
elements.html: Preserve the route, delay and date context.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l10.claim.feedback.fake
elements.html: The problem is missing context, not the format alone.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l10.share
elements.title: What should you share, if anything?

choices.text: A dated correction with the official page, or wait if you cannot verify the page.
The dramatic version because it spreads faster.
A guarantee that no future service change can occur.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l10.share.feedback.correct
elements.html: Both correction and withholding can be responsible.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l10.share.feedback.viral
elements.html: Reach does not make it reliable.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l10.share.feedback.certainty
elements.html: The page describes current information, not all future events.

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l10.transfer
elements.title: Write a short correction with source, date context and one limitation. You may instead explain why you would wait to share.
elements.description: Practice text only. Saved on this device. Reviewed by you or an educator, not AI graded.

validators.text: Add enough reasoning to review (at least 30 characters).

elements.name: lai.ai-you-can-use.l10.rubric
elements.html:
Self-check

  • Corrects the all-buses claim.
  • Identifies original relevant source and time context.
  • Avoids overstating certainty or shaming people who were misled.

All notices here are fictional. For real safety or travel decisions, use the responsible authority’s current information.
